risks.proof: Close-up photos of the stand joints, wheel axle, and machine bed in good lighting.

risks.risk: Drive belt may be missing, cracked, or perished, which is essential for treadle operation.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the belt path from wheel to hand-wheel pulley on the head.

risks.risk: Wooden table/treadle board may have cracks, woodworm, or instability.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the wood grain, edges, and underside of the table.
risks.if_unproven: priced as wood in poor condition

risks.risk: Completeness of accessory set (bobbins, extra needles, attachments) claimed by seller's checklist is unverified.

proof_requests: Video of the treadle in motion with the needle stitching a piece of fabric.
Close-up photo of any brand nameplate/decal on the machine arm or bed.

Photos of the underside of the table and the stand joints for rust/wood damage.

response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a manual treadle sewing machine with stand, but brand and working condition are unverifiable from the single photo, so it must be priced at worst case (unconfirmed brand, assumed non-working, unverified completeness) pending the requested proof.
